DIAGNOSIS READY: CMV Retinitis

The patient reports decreased vision and floaters ("black spots") in the right eye with no pain, which is a classic presentation for Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis in an AIDS patient. Given the lack of pain and the specific description of floaters, this does not align with Tuberculosis.
